documents.title: Карта Руси около 862 года
documents.institution: Н. Н. Торнау; цифровая копия Wikimedia Commons

date.note: Publication date of the reconstruction map; the represented historical date is circa 862.

documents.publicationCitation: Торнау Н. Н. Учебный атлас по русской истории. Санкт-Петербург, 1910. Карта Руси около 862 года.
documents.notes: Use only as a reproducibly digitized secondary reconstruction layer. The map must not be presented as an exact ninth-century surveyed frontier. Primary chronicle evidence remains separate and controls the historical chronology; geometry retains low confidence and explicit uncertainty.

documents.title: Границы России — подробнее о проекте и метод диапазонов
documents.institution: Руниверс / Лаборатория исторической геоинформатики ИВИ РАН

date.note: Project-generation era; methodology page describes the dynamic historical GIS and its limitations.

documents.publicationCitation: Руниверс. «Границы России»: методология исторической динамической карты; Фролов А. А., ИВИ РАН.
documents.notes: States explicitly that many ancient boundaries are conventional, that historical boundary segments are stored with lower/upper dates, and that the web application generates yearly polygon slices. History Core adopts the uncertainty principle but not the web project's artificial January 1 dates for year-only events.

documents.title: Границы России и предшественников, 850–2020 — технологическое описание
documents.institution: NextGIS / Руниверс / Лаборатория исторической геоинформатики ИВИ РАН
documents.notes: Documents that IVI RAS specialists digitized each boundary segment from multiple historical sources, assigned validity ranges, and generated polygon time slices through NextGIS processing.

documents.title: Древнерусское государство в IX–XI вв. (до 1054 г.)
documents.publicationCitation: Древнерусское государство в IX—XI вв. (до 1054 г.) / сост. Науч.-ред. картосост. частью ГУГК в 1941 г.; консультант Б. А. Рыбаков; ред. К. Б. Мартова. Испр. 1952. М.: ГУГК, 1961. 1:3 000 000.
documents.notes: RSL catalog states that the map has a geographic graticule and separately colors the Old Russian state under Oleg (882–912), lands added 912–971, and lands added 972–1054. Use as a low-confidence scholarly reconstruction cross-check with primary chronicle evidence; do not infer intra-period dates absent from the source.

documents.title: Русь в удельное время, 1054–1240
documents.institution: Н. Н. Торнау; цифровая копия Wikimedia Commons

date.note: Publication date of the reconstruction map; represented interval is 1054–1240.

documents.publicationCitation: Торнау Н. Н. Учебный атлас по русской истории. Санкт-Петербург, 1910. Русь в удельное время, 1054–1240.
documents.notes: Wikimedia Commons identifies this 1910 Tornau raster as public domain and free of known copyright restrictions. The exact Commons raster bytes are hash-pinned for reproducibility. It is a production-eligible raster source candidate, but no geometry is promoted until explicit GCP georeferencing and the intended historical layer are traced reproducibly with uncertainty.
